desc: The Bore-Max Master Cleaning Kit and Mobile Workstation is designed to revolutionize the way firearms are maintained. This kit provides an all-in-one solution, featuring an array of precision tools and innovative technologies to ensure comprehensive caliber specific cleaning and maintenance including .22 – .45 CAL Pistol, .223 CAL / 5.56MM – .30 CAL / 7.62MM Rifle and 20 & 12 GA Shotgun. From the robust Gun Gripper technology ensuring secure firearm handling to the Smart-Assist Quick-Connect lighting for enhanced visibility, every aspect of the kit is crafted for efficiency and effectiveness. The Mobile Workstation offers unparalleled portability, allowing users to perform maintenance tasks anywhere, while the Bore-Max Speed Clean System guarantees a faster, more thorough cleaning process. The removable lid doubles as a drip pan or parts tray, enhancing the cleaning process. Equipped with the Bore-Max 3-Piece Smart Rod, nickel plated double-density brushes, speed jags and a Smart-Fit Bore Guide, this kit is engineered to deliver superior performance and reliability. It’s an essential tool for any firearm enthusiast seeking to maintain their arsenal in peak condition.
